unit_name: LXIV Corps (LXIV Reserve Corps until 5 August 1944)
current_activity: The LXIV Corps (Thumm) takes over the former LXXXIX Corps zone from Domèvre to Saulcy-sur-Meurthe
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 19 p. 338: "General Wiese had to shift the zone of Thumm's LXIV Corps northward to take over the LXXXIX Corps sector. "to Saulcy-sur-Meurthe"; p. 339: "These command and control changes had become effective between 30 October and 1 November". Location support: CMH names the two ends of the front. Commander: General Thumm. Context: the LXXXIX Corps headquarters (von Gilsa) was transferred to the First Army.
